job.title: Recruiter
job.description:
Casual Blue Collar Recruiter – Ongoing Assignment

Naval Base | Full-Time Hours | $55 per hour + super | Immediate Start

The Opportunity

TCB Recruitment is currently seeking an experienced Recruiter to join our client’s team based in Naval Base.

This is an ongoing casual opportunity working full-time hours, ideal for a blue collar recruiter who enjoys a fast-paced environment and can hit the ground running.

We are looking for someone who can start ASAP!

About the Role

You will be responsible for supporting the recruitment function across a range of roles, managing candidates through the recruitment process and working closely with internal stakeholders.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Managing end-to-end recruitment activities - blue collar roles with some white collar

  • Sourcing and identifying suitable candidates

  • Reviewing applications and conducting candidate screening

  • Conducting phone and initial interviews

  • Coordinating interviews with hiring managers

  • Preparing candidate shortlists and recruitment documentation

  • Maintaining accurate candidate and recruitment records

  • Supporting onboarding and pre-employment processes

  • Building strong relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders

  • Providing general recruitment support as required

About You

We’re looking for a hands-on Blue Collar Recruiter who can step in and make an immediate impact.

You will ideally have:

  • Previous recruitment experience in an agency or internal environment

  • Experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes

  • Strong candidate sourcing and screening skills

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Strong organisation and attention to detail

  • The ability to manage multiple vacancies and competing priorities

  • A proactive, can-do approach

  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team

Experience recruiting within industrial, manufacturing, construction, engineering, mining or similar environments will be highly regarded.

What's on Offer

  • $55 per hour + super

  • Casual ongoing position

  • Full-time hours

  • Based in Naval Base

  • ASAP start

  • Opportunity to join a busy and supportive recruitment environment

  • Ongoing work for the right person

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Recruiter who is available immediately and ready to get started, we want to hear from you!

Apply now with your CV, or contact TCB Recruitment for more information.

Please note: This is an ongoing casual position working full-time hours. An immediate start is required.

job.title: Site Supervisor / Project Manager
job.description:
$150K+ Super + Company 4WD + Fuel Card + Phone & Laptop
Full-Time | Permanent | Relocate to Perth
Lead People. Deliver Projects. Make Your Mark.

TCB Recruitment is proud to partner with one of Western Australia’s leading commercial fencing contractors as they continue to experience strong growth and expansion. We are seeking an experienced Site Supervisor / Project Manager who is looking to relocate to Perth to join their growing team and play a key role in delivering a growing pipeline of commercial projects across WA.

Our client delivers fencing solutions across civil infrastructure, land development, government and commercial projects throughout Perth and surrounding areas. With a strong reputation built on quality workmanship, trusted relationships and exceptional people, they are entering an exciting phase of growth and are seeking a leader who can help drive the business forward.

This is not an office-bound site supervisor / project manager role. It's a hands-on leadership position for someone who enjoys supporting people, solving problems and taking ownership of outcomes.

The Opportunity
Reporting to Senior Leadership, you will oversee multiple commercial fencing projects and lead several field crews across Perth. You'll spend much of your time visiting sites, supporting Team Leaders, meeting with clients and ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and profitably.
A dedicated Estimating team manages quotations, allowing you to focus on leading people and delivering successful projects.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead multiple commercial fencing crews across active projects
  • Coach, mentor and develop Team Leaders
  • Coordinate labour, materials, plant and subcontractors
  • Conduct regular site visits and provide leadership to field teams
  • Build strong relationships with clients and stakeholders
  • Identify and resolve issues before they impact delivery
  • Monitor project performance, productivity and profitability
  • Recruit, develop and retain high-performing team members
  • Drive continuous improvement across the business
About You
We're seeking someone with strong leadership capability and a practical approach to project delivery. You are someone who:
  • Leads by example and earns the respect of your team
  • Takes ownership and follows through on commitments
  • Builds strong relationships with clients and colleagues
  • Solves problems and keeps projects moving
  • Develops people and creates high-performing teams
  • Thrives in a fast-paced construction environment
Skills & Experience
  • Proven experience as a Project Manager, Site Supervisor or similar leadership role
  • Commercial fencing experience is essential
  • Strong understanding of commercial fencing projects, site operations and project delivery
  • Strong leadership and communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities
  • Experience with machine-based site work or excavators is highly regarded
  • Trade background in carpentry, civil construction or related fields highly desirable
  • Current Driver's Licence essential
  • HC/MC Licence and additional tickets are advantageous

What's On Offer?
✔ Attractive package of $150K+ Super
✔ Company 4WD with fuel card (private use permitted)
✔ Phone and laptop provided
✔ Permanent, full-time opportunity
✔ Diverse commercial projects across Perth – no FIFO

job.title: Contract Administrator
job.description:
Site-Based | 8:6 FIFO Roster | 18–24 Month Contract | WA

We are currently recruiting two Contract Administrators to join a major lithium project at Kathleen Valley.

This is an excellent opportunity for experienced Contract Administrators to join a fast-paced construction environment and play a key role in the commercial and contractual delivery of a major WA project.

The Role

Reporting to the Commercial Lead and working closely with the Construction Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day administration of head contracts and subcontracts, ensuring contractual compliance, accurate commercial reporting and effective stakeholder relationships across the project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer head contracts and subcontracts in accordance with contractual terms and conditions

  • Prepare, review and process progress claims, payment certificates and invoices

  • Manage and track variations, extensions of time (EOTs) and contractual claims

  • Maintain accurate contract registers, correspondence logs and project documentation

  • Monitor contractor compliance with scope, program and contractual obligations

  • Liaise with site supervisors, engineers, subcontractors and project stakeholders on contractual and commercial matters

  • Support the Commercial Lead with contractual correspondence, including notices, instructions and RFIs

  • Assist with procurement and preparation of new subcontract packages

  • Support cost control and commercial reporting, including cost-to-complete forecasting

  • Identify and escalate contractual risks, issues and potential disputes

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures and relevant legislation

  • Assist with contract close-out, including final accounts and release of retentions

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Proven experience as a Contract Administrator within major construction, mining or resources projects

  • Strong understanding of contract administration principles and commercial processes

  • Experience managing variations, claims, EOTs and progress payments

  • Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Confidence working with site-based teams, subcontractors and project stakeholders

  • Ability to work autonomously in a FIFO, site-based environment

  • A current White Card

  • Ability to successfully complete a pre-employment medical and relevant site requirements

What's on Offer

  • 8:6 FIFO roster to Kathleen Valley

  • 18–24 month contract

  • Competitive hourly rate

  • Major lithium project with strong project exposure

  • Opportunity to work alongside an experienced commercial and construction team

  • Site-based role with the opportunity to make a genuine impact on project delivery

Apply Now

Two positions available – immediate requirement.

If you're an experienced Contract Administrator looking for your next FIFO project opportunity, apply now with your current resume to be considered or call us on 1300 014 394

job.title: Social Media and Relations Investor Coordinator
job.description:
Social Media & Investor Relations Coordinator

Perth, WA | Full-time | Occasional Travel

Bring together your creativity, digital expertise and interest in the mining and commodities sector

Are you a highly organised digital marketing professional who loves creating engaging content, delivering polished communications and keeping multiple priorities moving?

This is an exciting opportunity to join a close-knit, collaborative team in a varied role spanning social media, investor relations, digital marketing, content creation and client reporting.

You will work in a fast-paced, professional environment supporting clients across the mining and commodities sector. From promoting market announcements and producing newsletters to coordinating podcasts, webinars and industry events, no two days will be the same.

Why you’ll love this role

  • Make the role your own across social media, content and investor communications

  • Work closely with a supportive, professional and close-knit team

  • Build valuable experience within the mining, commodities and investor relations sectors

  • Create content across social media, newsletters, podcasts, websites and events

  • Attend industry conferences and provide on-site social media coverage

  • Enjoy a diverse role that combines creativity, client service and commercial awareness

The opportunity

As the Social Media and Investor Relations Coordinator, you will manage day-to-day digital content, coordinate client communications and reporting, and help maintain a professional and consistent presence across multiple platforms.

You will be someone who takes pride in producing accurate, high-quality work and understands that, within investor relations, every detail matters. You will balance creative thinking with the professionalism, accuracy and compliance awareness required when communicating market-sensitive information.

Key responsibilities

Social media and content creation

  • Plan, create and publish daily and weekly social media content

  • Promote client announcements, market updates, industry news and events

  • Create professional, on-brand graphics and video content using Canva

  • Support the development and launch of newsletters, including creative assets and email distribution

  • Upload and promote the weekly podcast across relevant digital channels

  • Establish and optimise new social media accounts when required

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client biographies and online profiles

  • Strengthen brand consistency across company and client digital platforms

  • Schedule and manage content using Hootsuite

Email marketing and website coordination

  • Design, build and distribute email campaigns and client announcements through Mailchimp

  • Complete daily and weekly website updates

  • Ensure online information remains accurate, relevant and current

  • Coordinate webinar advertising and promotional campaigns

  • Track webinar registrations and manage supporting marketing materials

  • Coordinate digital advertising and content for industry conferences and events

Reporting, monitoring and operational support

  • Compile, manage and distribute accurate internal and client reports within required timeframes

  • Conduct daily media monitoring across industry news, client coverage and market developments

  • Liaise with photographers, designers and other external suppliers

  • Support cross-marketing initiatives across different areas of the business

  • Provide on-site social media and content support at industry conferences

  • Assist with other marketing and investor relations activities as required

What you will bring

  • Previous experience in social media, digital marketing, communications or a related coordination role

  • Confidence using Hootsuite or similar social media management platforms

  • Strong Canva skills, including the ability to create polished graphics and video content

  • Experience using Mailchimp or a comparable email marketing platform

  • Hands-on experience updating websites through a content management system

  • An understanding of investor relations principles

  • An interest in, or foundational knowledge of, the mining and commodities sector

  • Exceptional written communication and proofreading skills

  • Impeccable attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, error-free work

  • The ability to manage competing deadlines without compromising quality

  • Professional and responsive customer and client service skills

  • A proactive, adaptable and solutions-focused approach

  • The ability to work collaboratively within a small, close-knit team

  • Availability to travel occasionally for industry conferences and events

The person our client is looking for

A naturally organised, dependable and meticulous. You enjoy being part of a team, but you are equally comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities and keeping work moving without needing constant direction.

You understand how to adapt your tone for different audiences and can move confidently between creative content, professional client communications and detailed reporting. Most importantly, you care about getting things right and take genuine pride in the quality of your work.

Ready to take the next step?

If you are looking for a varied role where you can combine your creativity, digital marketing experience and interest in the mining and commodities sector, we would love to hear from you.

Click Apply Now and submit your resume along with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience. If available, we also encourage you to include examples of social media content, digital campaigns, newsletters or creative work you have produced.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, so we encourage you to apply promptly.

Whether you're looking to start a career in construction or build on your existing experience, this is an excellent opportunity to join a company that genuinely invests in its employees.

job.title: Site Supervisor
job.description:
Site Supervisor | Residential Construction

Perth, WA | Full-Time | Competitive Salary + Vehicle + Career Growth

Our client, located in Byford, is seeking an experienced Site Supervisor to oversee the day-to-day delivery of construction projects, ensuring work is completed safely, on schedule, and to the highest quality standards.

We're looking for a motivated and hands-on Site Supervisor to join a growing team where your leadership, organisation, and commitment to quality will make a real impact.

About the Role

As the Site Supervisor, you'll be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations across multiple residential construction sites. Working closely with Project Managers, trades, subcontractors, and suppliers, you'll ensure projects are delivered efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of safety, workmanship, and customer satisfaction.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys being on-site, leading teams, solving problems, and driving successful project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily site operations from commencement through to completion.
  • Coordinate trades, subcontractors, materials, and equipment.
  • Ensure all work is completed in accordance with plans, specifications, and quality standards.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively address any issues or delays.
  • Lead, mentor, and support site personnel to achieve high performance.
  • Conduct site inspections and maintain quality control throughout construction.
  • Ensure compliance with Australian building standards and company procedures.
  • Maintain accurate site documentation, reports, and records.
  • Liaise professionally with Project Managers, clients, suppliers, and subcontractors.
  • Promote and maintain a strong safety-first culture across all sites.

Safety is a Priority

You'll play a key role in ensuring all work is completed safely by:

  • Conducting site inspections and hazard identification.
  • Leading toolbox talks and site inductions.
  • Ensuring compliance with all WHS legislation and company policies.
  • Investigating incidents and implementing corrective actions.
  • Promoting best-practice safety across every project.

About You

To be successful, you'll bring:

  • Trade qualification or relevant qualification in Construction or Building.
  • White Card (essential).
  • Certificate IV in Work Health & Safety (or equivalent).
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence.
  • Minimum 3-5 years' experience supervising construction sites.
  • Experience managing residential construction projects.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian building standards and construction methods.
  • Excellent leadership and people management skills.
  • Strong organisational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
  • A proactive approach with a focus on quality, safety, and delivering results.

What's on Offer?

  • Competitive salary package.
  • Company vehicle (or vehicle allowance, if applicable).
  • Stable, full-time opportunity with a growing business.
  • Supportive leadership team and positive workplace culture.
  • Opportunities for career progression and professional development.
  • The chance to work on quality residential construction projects across Perth.

Apply Now

If you're an experienced Site Supervisor looking to join a company that values safety, quality, and teamwork, we'd love to hear from you.

Click Apply Now and submit your resume today or give us a call to discuss the role further
